intro: Pathways is the Toastmasters education program: six learning paths of five levels each, which members work through at their own pace. Whether you're building confidence, developing leadership skills or becoming a more influential communicator, there's a path designed for you.
journeyLine: Your Toastmasters journey evolves as your goals evolve.

stages.name: First-timer
stages.text: Your first speech, your first Table Topic, your first applause.

stages.name: Confident speaker
stages.text: Clear, calm and persuasive, at work and beyond.

stages.name: Leader
stages.text: Run meetings, lead projects, serve on the committee.

stages.name: Mentor
stages.text: Help the next nervous first-timer find their voice.

levels.name: Mastering Fundamentals
levels.text: Your Ice Breaker, writing a speech with purpose, voice and body language, and learning to give feedback.

levels.name: Learning Your Style
levels.text: Find your own speaking style, and take your first steps as a mentor.

levels.name: Increasing Knowledge
levels.text: Your path's core skill, plus two electives you choose.

levels.name: Building Skills
levels.text: Use those skills in harder situations, plus one elective.

levels.name: Demonstrating Expertise
levels.text: A capstone project that shows what you've learned, and a reflection on your path.

facts.title: Your first path is included
facts.text: Every new member gets their first path free with membership.

facts.title: 15 projects, 5 levels
facts.text: Eleven required projects and four you choose yourself.

facts.title: Practised at real meetings
facts.text: Each project is a speech or a role you deliver at the club, with a fellow member's evaluation.

facts.title: Online in Base Camp
facts.text: Projects, videos and evaluations live in Base Camp, Toastmasters' online learning platform.

facts.title: Six languages
facts.text: Arabic, English, French, German, Simplified Chinese and Spanish.

facts.title: Not sure? Take the assessment
facts.text: Toastmasters' online assessment suggests three paths from your goals and interests.

paths.name: Presentation Mastery
paths.focus: Write and deliver speeches that connect, from your first story to a talk you could give professionally.

paths.name: Dynamic Leadership
paths.focus: Lead through conflict and change, and put your leadership into practice with a real project.

paths.name: Persuasive Influence
paths.focus: Negotiate good outcomes, resolve conflict and lead well when situations get difficult.

paths.name: Motivational Strategies
paths.focus: Understand what motivates people, connect with them, and build a stronger team.

paths.name: Visionary Communication
paths.focus: Plan how you communicate, share ideas with a group, and develop a long-term vision.

paths.name: Engaging Humor
paths.focus: Find your own sense of humour and use it to hold a room, even when you speak off the cuff.

retired: Effective Coaching, Innovative Planning, Leadership Development, Strategic Relationships and Team Collaboration were withdrawn for new members on 23 October 2024. Members who started one can still finish it.

places.label: At work
places.line: Members use it straight away in meetings and presentations.

places.label: In my studies
places.line: Members use it for presentations, interviews and debates.

places.label: In my own business
places.line: Members use it for pitches and client conversations.

places.label: In my community
places.line: Members use it to speak up at events and in their community.
